proposal.claim:
ORIGIN, STATED FIRST, AND THE NOTEBOOK AUDIT THAT PRODUCED IT. reports/SCOUT.jsonl now holds eighteen payers and I read every line. Not one of them is reachable, and the reason is the evaluator rather than the notebook, so I state the audit instead of dressing one of them up. Twelve are anchored to a wall-clock instant or an announcement -- the quarterly 07:00-08:00 UTC delivery fixing on the last Friday of a quarter (line 0), the pre-announced margin-tier change (1), the delisting settlement hour (3), the Deribit 07:30-08:00 expiry window (5), the Dual Investment 07:30-08:00 fixing (7), the Monday 00:00 UTC liquidity-provider tier reset (8), the daily 00:00 UTC tournament qualification reset (17), the jurisdiction offboarding deadlines of 2021-12-23 and 2023-07-17 (13), the CME 15:00-16:00 London hour (14), the BUSD collateral wind-down dates (2), the Launchpool programme calendar (16) -- and no field of TrialConfig or SignalTrialConfig names a date, an hour or a weekday. A Track A programme is anchored only to its own start offset, the runner enumerates offsets on a fixed stride and reports a percentile taken across all of them, so any weekday or hour-of-day phase is averaged away by construction rather than measured. Five more -- forced short covering (4), ADL (6), leveraged-token rebalancing (10), copy-trade replication (11), TWAP child orders (12) -- need either an intrabar forced-flow proxy or a rule that trades WITH the move, and both are absent: H0008 died discovering the first, and H0013 died discovering the second, because orc/eval/simulate.py gate_below_sma is out[ok] = close[ok] <= sma[ok], so sma:<days> is a weakness-buying gate of the same sign as dip: rather than a trend gate. Line 15, the Mark-Price index dislocation, has an observable in the bars, but the only rule that stands against it is a short-lookback dip gate, which is the identical code path and gate axis on which H0009 was killed as a re-skin of closed H0007; proposing it again would spend this pass for nothing. Line 9, the venue outage, is the one whose observable is fully reachable from the held panel, and the scout line says so itself -- but bars missing simultaneously across the cross-section is data forensics rather than a rule any config field expresses, and its honest home is a scout or kernel_review pass at zero ledger rows. That is the audit. This proposal therefore comes from KT-1's own measured payer, and the rest of this claim is why that payer is not H0002's and why the shape is not one already run.

WHO IS STRUCTURALLY PAYING, AND WHY THEY KEEP DOING IT. The crowded leveraged long on a Binance USDs-M perpetual. The venue's margin system holds no spot rail: inside a USDs-M account the only way to hold the exposure is the perpetual, and the perpetual charges the crowded side of the contract every eight hours for as long as the position is open. KT-1 measured that bill from the paying side and the figures are in CLAUDE.md section 7 -- a median 36 percent of contributed capital over a three-year weekly DCA, with 87 percent of BTC settlements positive. They keep paying because the alternative is to give up the exposure; there is no cheaper way to hold it on this venue, which is what makes the payment structural rather than a bad quarter. It ends the day a USDs-M account can post the spot asset as the exposure itself.

WHY THE PAYMENT SURVIVES SCALE, WHICH IS THE OBJECTION THAT KILLED H0014. codex closed H0014 because the named payer was the strategy itself, and because avoided self-incurred funding cost is not a structural counterparty that continues transferring value when the rule scales. That objection is correct and it does not reach here. Funding is not a cost avoided; it is a transfer between the two sides of one contract, settled by the venue, and its size is set by the crowding of the paying side rather than by ours. Value moves from an identified counterparty to us at every settlement, and the only thing our size changes is our share of it.

WHY THIS PAYER IS NOT H0002'S AND WHY THE SHAPE IS NOT H0002'S. H0002 stood on the same tax and is closed, so the burden is on the difference and I put it in the shape rather than in the payer. H0002 is a Track B SIGNAL rule on FIXED capital: enter short when the funding rate crosses enter_rate, exit on a threshold, a stop or max_hold, one equity curve per symbol. Its closure answers whether TIMING the carry works, and reports/SURFACE_READING.md says what its surface pointed at instead: every axis improves in the direction of trading less, the best cells converge on zero, and the (max_hold null, stop_loss null) cells are structural cells with no liquidation path, pinned near -1.0. That limit -- never enter on a signal, never exit, never risk one stake -- is not a cell of H0002's grid and cannot be made one, because under fixed capital always short and one stake compounded to nothing through an up-move are the same object. External deposits break that identity: an accumulating short's notional is rebuilt from outside the account every stride, so whether it survives an up-move becomes a question about the deposit schedule rather than about a single stake. That is a different rule shape with a different failure mode, and the ledger holds no row for it -- every Track A row runs long, and no row carries leverage below zero. H0006 is the opposite side of the same signal question and is likewise closed. H0007 and H0009 stood on the liquidated leveraged long and a dip gate, which is neither this payer nor this shape. H0001 names no payer and is the long-side control this is the mirror of.

WHY THIS DOES NOT RE-OPEN A CLOSED RESULT. KT-1 closed perpetual LONG DCA. CLAUDE.md's opening paragraph names the mirror as the open question in the same sentence: the mirror of that tax, standing on the side that collects funding, is the first family Track B asks about. KT-2 closed leverage ABOVE 1x for averaging-down; every magnitude here is exactly 1.0. H0011 was killed for varying H0001's hold_days and stride_days on H0001's own long rule form, and H0012 for sweeping H0001's leverage between 0.25 and 1.0 on that same form; neither objection is answered by a sign flip alone, which is why leverage is FIXED here rather than swept, and why the grid's numeric axis has to earn itself on its own argument, below.

THE RULE SHAPE AND WHY n_contributions IS THE AXIS THAT MATTERS. A weekly ladder of equal deposits into a short at unit notional, held to horizon, with no gate, no take-profit and no stop. The one numeric axis is the number of deposits, four levels at a fixed weekly stride: 26, 52, 104 and 156, that is half a year, one year, two years and KT-1's own three-year frame. This is not H0001's horizon axis re-asked, because on a short the two legs of the outcome move in OPPOSITE directions along it. reports/SURFACE_READING.md establishes that H0001's entire long surface is a monotone rising function of stride times n -- BTC funding-off runs 52d -0.961 through 1560d +0.362 without a single reversal -- so on the mirror the price leg falls monotonically along the same axis, while the collected funding leg rises with standing notional-time. Where those two cross is the whole question, and nothing in the ledger implies it: no recorded row has a short leg to cross. Four levels also give 52 and 104 a neighbour on each side, so the shape diagnostic has something to read, which is what H0006 and H0007 lacked. include_funding is the second axis and is a control, not a parameter: the funding-off arm is the price-only counterfactual, and clause 2 is the difference between the arms at one fixed horizon. claude's objection to H0011 was that an include_funding axis reconstructs by subtraction a bill the runner already records as funding_frac_q50; that is not what it does here -- funding_frac_q50 is read directly in clause 3, and the axis exists to isolate the PRICE leg, which no recorded field supplies for a path that can liquidate.

THE UNIVERSE, AND WHY IT IS ADVERSE-FIRST. Six symbols, forty-eight configurations, inside MAX_PROBE_CONFIGURATIONS for a mechanism with no rows. Three are above zero on H0001's published baseline in reports/CYCLE_REPORT.md (BTCUSDT +0.362, ETHUSDT +0.679, SOLUSDT +0.373) and three below it (XRPUSDT -0.053, DOGEUSDT -0.099, ADAUSDT -0.320). For a long that split is neutral; for a SHORT it is deliberately hostile, because the three that rose are the ones a short cannot survive on price. Putting them in the universe is what stops this family being read on a set that only fell. The split is a property of the control and is already published; it is not a selection on anything about the short, which has no rows to select on. All six are known to admit the weekly (156, 7) schedule, since CYCLE_REPORT.md reports that cell for each of them.

WHAT THIS IS A PARTIAL TEST OF, AND THE FOUR THINGS IT CANNOT REACH. First and largest: the development window contains one alt bear market -- six of nine symbols on H0001's published baseline are below zero -- so a short will look good for reasons that have nothing to do with the payer named here. Clause 3's cross-symbol ordering against the recorded funding bill is the only thing forcing the mechanism to be the thing measured, and it is a weak test in the direction of survival by construction. Second: with 1092-day programmes on a pre-seal window of roughly four years, the independent-path count will be about one per symbol. Six symbols is six experiments, not the thousands of start offsets the runner will print, and any surviving number must be reported that way. Third: liquidation on the short side is the venue closing us at a Mark Price we do not set, which is scout line 15's payer arriving on the other side of the trade; this hypothesis records liquidation_rate as an outcome and makes no attempt to separate an index-rule closure from an ordinary one, which would need the Index and Mark series the project does not hold. Fourth, and this is the one thing I could not check with the tools this pass allows: whether orc/eval/simulate.py expresses leverage below zero as a short at all. leverage is a float field of TrialConfig, so this proposal will not expand to a TypeError, but if the simulator takes a magnitude or clamps at zero then every cell here is a duplicate of the sweep already refused as H0012 and this proposal should be killed on exactly that ground. One read of the position-sizing line settles it, the adversary has that tool and this pass does not, and clause 0 below is written so that the run itself would also catch it. I say it rather than assume it because H0013 died for asserting a gate's sign without checking it.

ONE PRE-EMPTION. That the adversary can run these forty-eight cells in under a minute at zero ledger rows is true of every hypothesis this project will ever propose. It was decisive against H0012 and H0014 because the answers there were already implied -- by KT-2 and monotonicity in the first case, by a metric artefact in the second. Here no recorded row carries a short leg, the crossing point of the two legs along the horizon axis is unmeasured, and clause 3's ordering against the recorded bill is implied by nothing in the ledger.
proposal.kill_condition:
NOTATION. Every cell is contribution 100.0, stride_days 7.0, hold_days 0.0, leverage -1.0, gate none, take_profit null, stop_loss null, clock 1h. For symbol s and n in {26, 52, 104, 156}: T(s, n, f) is the recorded tm_q05 with include_funding = f; L(s, n) is the recorded liquidation_rate on the funded arm (include_funding true); F(s, n) is the recorded funding_frac_q50 on the funded arm. The universe is the six symbols listed. Every threshold below is frozen now, before any of these cells has been run.

WHICH METRIC, AND WHY. tm_q05 is PRIMARY_METRIC, and CLAUDE.md section 4 forbids comparing it between cells that hold for different lengths of time. n_contributions IS a horizon axis, so no clause below ever compares T across n within a symbol: every comparison is either between the two include_funding arms of the SAME cell, or between symbols at the SAME n. The annualised mwrr_q05 is reported for every cell alongside tm_q05 as section 4 requires, and is argued from in no clause, because claude's kill of H0014 established that it is pinned to the bracket floor -0.9999 whenever a path ends in liquidation and therefore reads as a ruin detector rather than a return. Liquidation is read directly, as liquidation_rate, in clause 1.

0. THE SIGN WAS DISCARDED. Closed immediately if, for any symbol and any n in {52, 104, 156}, T(s, n, true) equals the tm_q05 already recorded for H0001's (symbol, stride_days 7, n_contributions n, include_funding true) cell to within 1e-6. That identity means the evaluator took the magnitude of leverage and these rows are a duplicate of a recorded long rather than a short. This clause is a validity check, and firing it must be reported as VOID-AS-PROPOSED, not as a finding about the payer.

1. THE VENUE CLOSES IT BEFORE THE BILL IS COLLECTED. Closed if L(s, 156) >= 0.20 on four or more of the six symbols. An unlevered accumulating short that the liquidation engine closes on a fifth or more of start dates at the three-year horizon, on a majority of a universe chosen to contain both risen and fallen symbols, has no viable setting: the deposits rebuild the notional, but not fast enough to outlast an up-move. That is where this shape breaks and it is the publishable answer.

2. THE BILL IS NOT THE GAIN. Evaluate at the single fixed horizon n = 52, one year, the same for every symbol. D(s) = T(s, 52, true) - T(s, 52, false), the part of the terminal multiple attributable to funding at that horizon. Closed if D(s) < 0.05 on four or more of the six symbols. KT-1 measured the tax at a median 36 percent of contributed capital over three years of weekly deposits -- already expressed on contributed capital, so it already contains the ramp in standing notional -- which is of order 12 percent per year on the paying side. 0.05 is under half of that and is frozen now. If the collecting side does not receive at least that, the 36 percent does not go where this claim says it goes, and the mechanism is not what was measured.

3. IT IS THE WINDOW, NOT THE TAX. Order the six symbols by the absolute value of F(s, 52), the funding the short arm actually recorded at that horizon. Let Hi be the median of D(s) over the three symbols with the largest, and Lo the median of D(s) over the three with the smallest. Closed if Hi <= Lo. If ending up on the collecting side is what pays, the symbols where the settlements were largest must gain most; if the gain is unordered with respect to the recorded bill, what was measured is the development window's one alt bear market and not a transfer from the payer named in the claim. This clause is the discriminator and no single symbol can satisfy it. With six symbols split three and three it is deliberately asymmetric -- weak in the direction of survival and meaningful in the direction of closure -- so surviving it must be reported as not falsified, and never as confirmation.

4. IT IS A FITTED HORIZON, NOT A RULE. Closed if the project's own shape diagnostic reports SPIKE at the best cell on four or more of the six symbols. n_contributions carries four numeric levels, so 52 and 104 each have a neighbour on both sides and the diagnostic has something to read. A carry that exists at one holding length and not one step away is a corner of the grid, which CLAUDE.md section 6 says is not a finding no matter how large its value.

Closing requires any one clause to fire. Survival requires all five to fail, and survival does not make this shape a result: it earns a second registration under a new id, as section 6 provides for a mechanism that has survived its own kill condition. Any surviving number must be reported against an independent-path count of about one per symbol, six in total.

verdict.reason: [claude] 제안서가 스스로 확인하지 못했다고 밝힌 지점을 실제로 실행해 보면 orc/eval/simulate.py는 숏을 표현하지 못한다: leverage=-1.0이면 qty가 음수가 되어 has_pos = act & (qty > 0.0)이 영원히 False이므로 청산이 단 한 번도 평가되지 않고(6배 상승 구간에서도 liquidation_rate가 정확히 0.0), 동시에 ep = np.where(qty > 0.0, ...)가 진입가를 0으로 고정해 terminal_multiple이 tm_short = 1 - tm_long이라는 기계적 반사값으로 나온다(진입·청산 수수료 부호도 함께 뒤집혀 비용이 보조금이 된다). 따라서 핵심 조항 1(L(s,156) >= 0.20)은 구조상 절대 발화할 수 없고 PRIMARY_METRIC인 tm_q05는 숏의 종료배수가 아니며, 제안서가 마련한 유일한 안전장치인 조항 0은 magnitude 구현만 잡도록 쓰여 있어 실제 결함(1 - tm_long)을 통과시킨다. | [codex] The Track A simulator is explicitly long-only: it recognizes positions only when qty > 0 and tests liquidation against the bar low, so leverage -1 creates negative quantity that can never liquidate and is accounted with invalid long-side entry/exit conventions. Clause 0 will not catch this—negative leverage is not discarded—making the proposed short-carry results and liquidation clause invalid.
